summary: Data Mover: Sensitive Data Guardrails
description:
As a Data Mover user, I want Data Mover to identify and protect sensitive data before it reaches a destination, so transfers follow our data-handling policies. Add Foundry metadata-based detection and content-based detection of untagged sensitive data. Let users hash or remove sensitive columns, and block a table marked sensitive at the table level.

Jira issue: [CDO-4551](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4551)
Epic guide: [Data Mover: Sensitive Data Guardrails](../../docs/stories/CDO-4551-sensitive-data-guardrails-epic.md)
acceptance_criteria:
- Foundry table and column sensitivity markers are detected.
- A sensitive column can be hashed or removed before transfer.
- A table-level sensitive marker blocks the transfer.
- Content detectors identify untagged sensitive columns, including SSNs, and let users hash or remove those columns.
- Guardrail actions are enforced before destination writes, and findings do not expose sensitive cell values.

summary: Data Mover: Identify sensitive Foundry metadata
description:
As a pipeline owner, I want Data Mover to identify sensitivity tags in Foundry metadata so I can review sensitive tables and columns before transfer.

Jira issue: [CDO-4552](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4552)
Story guide: [Story CDO-4552 — Identify sensitive Foundry metadata](../../docs/stories/CDO-4552-identify-sensitive-foundry-metadata.md)
Epic guide: [Sensitive Data Guardrails](../../docs/stories/CDO-4551-sensitive-data-guardrails-epic.md)
acceptance_criteria:
- Data Mover checks Foundry metadata for configured sensitivity markers.
- Findings identify whether a marker applies to a table or a column.
- The review shows the affected table or column and that metadata triggered the finding.
- Findings do not expose sensitive cell values.

summary: Data Mover: Map Foundry sensitivity metadata
description:
Define how configured Foundry table and column markers map to Data Mover sensitivity findings.

Jira issue: [CDO-4553](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4553)
acceptance_criteria:
- Agreed Foundry markers map to table-level or column-level findings.
- The mapping is documented for the metadata reader and pipeline review.

summary: Data Mover: Read sensitivity markers from Foundry
description:
Extend Foundry source metadata handling to return table-level and column-level sensitivity markers.

Jira issue: [CDO-4554](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4554)
acceptance_criteria:
- Foundry metadata responses expose the configured table and column markers to Data Mover.
- Metadata handling does not include source cell values.

summary: Data Mover: Show Foundry metadata findings in pipeline review
description:
Display the affected tables and columns, and identify metadata as the source of each finding.

Jira issue: [CDO-4555](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4555)
acceptance_criteria:
- Pipeline review lists each affected table or column.
- Each finding is labeled as metadata-based and appears before transfer.

summary: Data Mover: Block tables marked sensitive
description:
As a pipeline owner, I want Data Mover to block a table marked sensitive in Foundry metadata so that the table cannot be transferred.

Jira issue: [CDO-4556](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4556)
Story guide: [Story CDO-4556 — Block tables marked sensitive](../../docs/stories/CDO-4556-block-tables-marked-sensitive.md)
Epic guide: [Sensitive Data Guardrails](../../docs/stories/CDO-4551-sensitive-data-guardrails-epic.md)
acceptance_criteria:
- A table-level sensitive marker blocks the run before extraction or destination writes begin.
- The run explains that the table-level marker caused the block.
- The block applies even if the table has no individually marked columns.

summary: Data Mover: Enforce table-level sensitivity blocks
description:
Prevent extraction and destination writes when a source table has a table-level sensitive marker.

Jira issue: [CDO-4557](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4557)
acceptance_criteria:
- A table-level sensitive marker prevents the run from extracting or writing the table.
- The run is recorded as blocked.

summary: Data Mover: Explain table-level sensitivity blocks
description:
Report the block reason and affected table in the run status.

Jira issue: [CDO-4558](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4558)
acceptance_criteria:
- Run status identifies the affected table and table-level sensitivity as the reason.
- The explanation contains no source cell values.

summary: Data Mover: Choose actions for metadata-tagged columns
description:
As a pipeline owner, I want to choose how Data Mover handles columns tagged as sensitive so I can hash or remove them before transfer.

Jira issue: [CDO-4559](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4559)
Story guide: [Story CDO-4559 — Choose actions for metadata-tagged columns](../../docs/stories/CDO-4559-choose-actions-for-metadata-tagged-columns.md)
Epic guide: [Sensitive Data Guardrails](../../docs/stories/CDO-4551-sensitive-data-guardrails-epic.md)
acceptance_criteria:
- For each metadata-tagged column, the user can choose Hash or Remove.
- A run cannot proceed while a tagged column has no selected action.
- The selected action is saved with the pipeline configuration and run.

summary: Data Mover: Add actions for metadata-tagged columns
description:
Provide Hash and Remove choices for each sensitive column found through metadata.

Jira issue: [CDO-4560](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4560)
acceptance_criteria:
- Each metadata-tagged column offers Hash and Remove choices.
- The selected choice is visibly associated with its column.

summary: Data Mover: Save metadata guardrail actions
description:
Persist each selected column action with the pipeline configuration and run snapshot.

Jira issue: [CDO-4561](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4561)
acceptance_criteria:
- The selected action is saved with the pipeline.
- The run snapshot captures the action used for that run.

summary: Data Mover: Validate metadata guardrail actions
description:
Prevent a run from proceeding when a metadata-tagged column has no selected action.

Jira issue: [CDO-4562](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4562)
acceptance_criteria:
- A metadata-tagged column without an action blocks the run before destination writes.
- The validation identifies the column requiring an action.

summary: Data Mover: Detect untagged SSNs in source data
description:
As a pipeline owner, I want Data Mover to detect SSNs in columns that lack sensitivity metadata so untagged sensitive data is still identified.

Jira issue: [CDO-4563](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4563)
Story guide: [Story CDO-4563 — Detect untagged SSNs in source data](../../docs/stories/CDO-4563-detect-untagged-ssns-in-source-data.md)
Epic guide: [Sensitive Data Guardrails](../../docs/stories/CDO-4551-sensitive-data-guardrails-epic.md)
acceptance_criteria:
- Data Mover runs an SSN detector against source values before writing to the destination.
- Findings identify the affected column and detector, without displaying matched values.
- The detector can be extended to support additional sensitive-data patterns.

summary: Data Mover: Implement SSN content detection
description:
Add a detector for supported SSN formats in source column values.

Jira issue: [CDO-4564](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4564)
acceptance_criteria:
- Supported SSN formats are detected and reported at column level.
- Findings identify the SSN detector without returning matched values.

summary: Data Mover: Scan source data before destination writes
description:
Run content detection before loading data into the destination.

Jira issue: [CDO-4565](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4565)
acceptance_criteria:
- Content detection scans source data in bounded batches before destination writes begin.
- No destination writes begin until the required scan completes.

summary: Data Mover: Return safe content detection findings
description:
Report affected columns and detector names without returning matched values.

Jira issue: [CDO-4566](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4566)
acceptance_criteria:
- Each finding identifies the column and detector.
- Matched values are excluded from the finding response.

summary: Data Mover: Choose actions for algorithm-detected columns
description:
As a pipeline owner, I want to choose how Data Mover handles columns flagged by content detectors so I can hash or remove them before transfer.

Jira issue: [CDO-4567](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4567)
Story guide: [Story CDO-4567 — Choose actions for algorithm-detected columns](../../docs/stories/CDO-4567-choose-actions-for-algorithm-detected-columns.md)
Epic guide: [Sensitive Data Guardrails](../../docs/stories/CDO-4551-sensitive-data-guardrails-epic.md)
acceptance_criteria:
- For each column flagged by a content detector, the user can choose Hash or Remove.
- A run cannot proceed with an unresolved finding.
- Findings show which detector identified the column, without exposing matched values.

summary: Data Mover: Add actions for content-detected columns
description:
Provide Hash and Remove choices for columns flagged by content detectors.

Jira issue: [CDO-4568](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4568)
acceptance_criteria:
- Each content-detected column offers Hash and Remove choices.
- The choice is associated with the finding and affected column.

summary: Data Mover: Save content guardrail actions
description:
Persist selected actions alongside the corresponding detector and column.

Jira issue: [CDO-4569](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4569)
acceptance_criteria:
- The saved action is associated with the detector and affected column.
- The run snapshot captures the action used for the run.

summary: Data Mover: Require resolution for content findings
description:
Prevent a run from proceeding when a detected column has no selected action.

Jira issue: [CDO-4570](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4570)
acceptance_criteria:
- An unresolved content finding blocks destination writes.
- The blocked run identifies the column and required decision without showing matched values.

summary: Data Mover: Apply guardrail actions before destination writes
description:
As a pipeline owner, I want Data Mover to enforce my selected actions consistently so sensitive columns are handled before transferred data reaches its destination.

Jira issue: [CDO-4571](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4571)
Story guide: [Story CDO-4571 — Apply guardrail actions before destination writes](../../docs/stories/CDO-4571-apply-guardrail-actions-before-destination-writes.md)
Epic guide: [Sensitive Data Guardrails](../../docs/stories/CDO-4551-sensitive-data-guardrails-epic.md)
acceptance_criteria:
- Hash and remove actions apply consistently across all transferred rows and batches.
- Removed columns are absent from the destination output.
- Hashed columns contain transformed values rather than source values.
- If a run finds a column with no configured action, it stops before destination writes begin and reports that the guardrail needs review.

summary: Data Mover: Implement the approved hash transform
description:
Apply the agreed one-way hash approach to selected columns before destination writes.

Jira issue: [CDO-4572](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4572)
acceptance_criteria:
- Selected values are transformed using the approved one-way hash approach.
- Raw values and hash-key material are not written to logs.

summary: Data Mover: Remove selected columns from transfer data
description:
Exclude selected columns consistently from transferred batches and destination output.

Jira issue: [CDO-4573](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4573)
acceptance_criteria:
- Removed columns are absent from every transferred batch and the destination schema.
- Remaining columns preserve their values and order according to the transfer contract.

summary: Data Mover: Enforce guardrail actions across transfer batches
description:
Apply each configured action consistently throughout the run and stop before destination writes if an action is unresolved.

Jira issue: [CDO-4574](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4574)
acceptance_criteria:
- The same action applies to the affected column in every batch.
- Unresolved findings prevent destination writes from beginning.

summary: Data Mover: Record guardrail findings and decisions
description:
As a pipeline owner, I want to review which guardrails ran and what actions were applied so I can understand and audit each transfer.

Jira issue: [CDO-4575](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4575)
Story guide: [Story CDO-4575 — Record guardrail findings and decisions](../../docs/stories/CDO-4575-record-guardrail-findings-and-decisions.md)

acceptance_criteria:

- Logs and audit records do not contain matched sensitive values.
- The run record identifies the applicable pipeline and guardrail configuration.

summary: Data Mover: Store guardrail findings and actions in run records
description:
Record detection sources, affected columns, selected actions, and block outcomes.

Jira issue: [CDO-4576](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4576)
acceptance_criteria:
- Run records capture detector or metadata source, affected column, action, and outcome.
- Run records exclude sensitive cell values.

summary: Data Mover: Show guardrail outcomes in run details
description:
Display findings and actions in the run review without showing sensitive values.

Jira issue: [CDO-4577](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4577)
acceptance_criteria:
- Run details show guardrail findings, selected actions, and block status.
- The view does not display matched source values.

summary: Data Mover: Keep sensitive values out of guardrail logs
description:
Ensure guardrail logging and audit records do not contain matched source values.

Jira issue: [CDO-4578](https://idstjira.socom.mil/jira/browse/CDO-4578)
acceptance_criteria:
- Guardrail events and audit records contain no matched source values.
